lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: I sure hope you're not thinking of doing something devious behind my back!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: Zeus, let me bring fire to the people!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: I can't allow for my people to suffer-

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: IT IS OUT OF THE QUESTION!!!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: And now they have to pay!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: Don't even think of asking me something preposterous like that ever again!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: Looks like I'll need to take matters into my own hands...
